purpose: Hard pre-publication quality gate for Confluence of Minds social content. Technical validity is necessary but never sufficient.

rules.concept: The viewer must understand the central idea or intentionally feel the intended mystery without prior knowledge of Confluence.
rules.world_fidelity: Read the project/world and its current assets before editing. Preserve its own visual, narrative, sonic and emotional language. No generic cross-world template.

visual_composition.crop: crop only when essential content remains intact; otherwise use designed background fill/padding
visual_composition.safe_area: Keep essential subject and text away from screen edges, bottom caption zone and right-side interaction rail. Inspect multiple frames.

rules.typography: Phone-readable, deliberately positioned, balanced and line-broken. No accidental off-centering, cramped edges or generic subtitle look.
rules.pacing: Duration serves the concept. 8 seconds is not a default. Transformation, blooming, explanation or emotional build may require 15-35+ seconds.
rules.sound: No silent short-form video unless silence is an explicit artistic choice. Use owned, original or clearly rights-safe music/audio that matches the world and is professionally mixed.
rules.motion_edit: Motion, cuts, transitions, reveals and stillness must be intentional and support the concept. Avoid cheap slideshow feeling.
rules.brand_impact: Do not publish if the social creative makes the underlying world feel cheaper, flatter or less distinctive.
rules.mobile_preview: Before approval, verify dimensions, duration, audio track, first/last frame, text safe zones, clipping and representative frames on a phone-oriented preview.
rules.rights_facts: Verify claims and rights for all visual/audio inputs.

approval_policy.fallback: NO POST TODAY - quality bar not met

must_convey: wishes/projects branching into a shared organism
blooming and revival as a beautiful event
RALUVAAA.visual_direction: Elegant, organic, luminous, immersive, alive. Show growth and blooming, not merely UI.
RALUVAAA.sonic_direction: Atmospheric, organic, planant; lightly japonisant may fit. Never generic corporate, toy-like or crude MIDI.
RALUVAAA.pacing: Give blooming and transformation enough time to be felt; do not compress the concept into a generic 8-second teaser.
